Provenance.drafts: Two rounds via ComfyUI MCP against the U3 Building clause (anchor-palette blockout -> img2img, IPAdapterAdvanced vit-h style-transfer w0.9 against market.png as the style reference). Round 1 (seed 700500, denoise 0.7, 4 candidates) missed the brief entirely: a display case plus street lamp, a market stall, a gazebo/shrine, and a runner-up with plaques but a blank bottom sheet -- none read as a noticeboard, abandoned. Round 2 (seed 700700, denoise 0.7, 4 candidates): #2 grew an antler-branch roof finial, #3 was busy with a blank bottom board, #4 was taller with its papers rendered too small. #1 (six posted papers, a small roofed cap, a hanging lantern, standing on its own sand pad) was the clean winner.
Provenance.paintoverNote: #1 from round 2 taken as-is, no inpaint needed -- the posted-papers read and the roofed-cap silhouette already matched the Building clause.
Provenance.aiDisclosure: AI-generated (SDXL base 1.0 + pixel-art-xl LoRA) diffuse, single ComfyUI KSampler pass (seed 700700, denoise 0.7) -- read directly from the PNG's own embedded ComfyUI workflow JSON, not quoted from memory. IPAdapterAdvanced (vit-h, style transfer, weight 0.9) referenced market.png so palette and lighting lock to the shipped Shop. DEVIATION from cutout.py: background removed via a deterministic flood-fill alpha matte (border-color median, border-seeded flood-fill of the core-background mask, then a fixed ~5px feather ring), not the BiRefNet model cutout.py wraps -- this render's backdrop measured near-uniform (border std < 1.1 per channel) so a segmentation-model pass bought nothing; cutout.py/BiRefNet remains the tool of record for gradient or busy backgrounds. Cropped to the alpha content box, then BOX-downsampled straight to 44x50 (no hard quantization) -- the same recipe market.png's own committed pixels were produced by. This is noticeboard's first build.json; the asset previously had no provenance record at all (not to be confused with props-noticeboard.build.json, which provenances a different manifest id -- a prop, not this building).
